name: meesho-social-commerce-scraper
title: Meesho Scraper - $2/1k, Prices & Price Monitor
description: Scrape Meesho search results with price, shipping-inclusive landed price, special-offer price, dispatch time, supplier state, attributes and images. Track price drops, rank moves and new ratings between runs.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

product-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each clean Meesho product saved to the dataset.
